FOOTBALL, NOT A BANKING APP

The last two passes were elegant and dead. This one is built on the thing people actually feel on a Thursday night: pitch green, floodlight yellow, chunky shirt numbers, confetti when you win.

Everything sits on a hard drop shadow so it feels like an object you press. The copy talks like a mate in the group chat. Every screen is live — go and press things.

WHAT TO TRY

Screen 2 — the teams are drawn on an actual pitch. You are the orange 8.

Screen 4 — confetti on full time, then vote man of the match.

Screen 3 — "I can't make it" → "Pass my shirt on". A bouncing ball while we find someone, then your money comes back on a big yellow card. Still the whole argument against CeleBreak, just no longer solemn about it.

THE BITS THAT MAKE PEOPLE COME BACK

The player card is a Panini sticker — shirt number, goals, streak, trophies. Built to be screenshotted into a group chat, which is free marketing.

The season table hands out medals and remembers that you have beaten Marco four times out of six. Bragging rights are the product.

THE RULES

Yellow is the action, green is the brand, orange is you. Every pressable thing sits on a hard shadow and squashes when you press it.

Motion is a reward, not decoration — it is spent on winning, scoring, and getting your money back. Nowhere else.
